import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String input = scanner.next();
        StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
        boolean hasAt = false;
        int index = 0;
        while (index < input.length()) {
            if (index + 2 < input.length() && input.substring(index, index + 3).equals("dot")) {
                output.append('.');
                index += 3;
            } else if (index + 1 < input.length() && input.substring(index, index + 2).equals("at") && !hasAt) {
                output.append('@');
                index += 2;
                hasAt = true;
            } else {
                output.append(input.charAt(index));
                index++;
            }
        }
        System.out.print(output.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
